purpose: Accumulate verified operational and discovery lessons without publishing user taste, source text, or model output.
guardrails: Current explicit search criteria always outrank learned discovery lessons.
User taste feedback is learned separately and may only rerank candidates that passed hard filters.
A transport or delivery ambiguity never becomes permission to resubmit model work.
Only verified resolutions become active lessons; a new error signature starts as observed.
Never store copyrighted source text, translated chapter text, full model answers, credentials, or private URLs in the lesson store.

seed_lessons.resolution: Treat the Steroids loopback 429 as pre-route local throttling: retry the same local request with bounded backoff and keep Project polling at 3 seconds. Do not create a replacement chat.
seed_lessons.guard: Applies only to the local bridge error code rate_limited, not ChatGPT provider 429 or ambiguous network failure.

seed_lessons.resolution: Stop launching new work globally. Keep already accepted operations durable. A pre-send failure may retry after cooldown; an after-send or uncertain delivery must not be resubmitted automatically.
seed_lessons.guard: Never infer pre-send safety from a missing answer alone.

seed_lessons.resolution: Use at most two distinct works concurrently, stagger new launches by at least 30 seconds, keep each work sequential, and prefer an existing work conversation before opening a third work.
seed_lessons.guard: This is the verified ChatGPT web transport profile for the current Mac/Steroids setup.

seed_lessons.resolution: Ask the same accepted work conversation once to re-emit the same operation envelope with JSON syntax corrected. Do not reread source, retranslate, or silently switch backend before that repair attempt finishes.
seed_lessons.guard: Only one repair turn per malformed answer hash. Uncertain repair delivery remains blocked.

seed_lessons.resolution: Keep the existing canonical glossary value, record the model proposal as a conflict decision, and commit an otherwise valid translation.
seed_lessons.guard: Structural glossary errors still fail closed.

seed_lessons.resolution: Retry only when local state has no worker/conversation identity and an exact broker status read proves there is no worker for the target. Otherwise preserve uncertainty and never resubmit automatically.
seed_lessons.guard: Broker lookup failure is not proof of absence.

seed_lessons.resolution: Use one Fieldnotes ChatGPT Project. Create one conversation per work and reuse that conversation for all chunks of the work. Keep Project Sources common; work source, glossary, ruby, context, and hidden proof live in the exact local task JSON.
seed_lessons.guard: Never reuse a different work conversation as evidence or context.

seed_lessons.resolution: Start every discovery from its own request snapshot/profile. Do not inherit hard filters, references, or exclusions from another entry unless the current profile explicitly carries them.
seed_lessons.guard: Global defaults and approved preference signals are the only cross-request inputs.

seed_lessons.resolution: Collect structured metadata broadly first, apply hard filters and dedupe, then spend body sampling on the strongest surviving candidates. Increase sample depth adaptively only when ranking uncertainty remains.
seed_lessons.guard: Do not fill a target count by deep-reading low-fit works.

seed_lessons.resolution: Rebuild and consult the persistent seen index before sampling/ranking. Collapse cross-posts using normalized title+author when possible and keep strict seen-index exclusion by default.
seed_lessons.guard: A user-requested revisit may override dedupe explicitly.

seed_lessons.resolution: When the request has no explicit length threshold, use 300k characters as the default main-lane floor but keep a small separate LENGTH EXCEPTION lane for unusually strong non-length fit.
seed_lessons.guard: Never mix short exceptions into the main shortlist merely to fill quota.

seed_lessons.resolution: Persist every actionable shortlist candidate's canonical platform URL in the JSON entry itself. HTML is a view, not the source of truth used by registration/acquisition.
seed_lessons.guard: Do not rely on presentation-only links for downstream automation.

seed_lessons.resolution: Return fewer candidates and report the gap when the qualified pool is small. Use marginal-yield stopping rather than promoting weak candidates to hit a fixed count.
seed_lessons.guard: Explicit user requests for a fixed count may broaden collection, but must not hide criteria violations.
